# AMEA Agro and Mining Export Alliance Limited

> AMEA is an indigenous Nigerian company, founded in 2017 and headquartered in Kano, that explores and mines solid minerals, develops integrated agriculture and builds export partnerships. It holds two Mining Leases and four Exploration Licences registered with Nigeria's Mining Cadastre Office, for gold, lithium (spodumene) and iron ore, in Niger and Kebbi States.

Key facts:

- Legal name: AMEA Agro and Mining Export Alliance Limited (RC 1417966), also known as AMEA
- Head office: No. 15 Guda Abdullahi Road, Farm Center, Kano, Nigeria
- Contact: info@amea.ng, +234 904 120 0000
- Licence titles: AUNAI Mining Lease (gold, lithium; Ngaski LGA), Shiroro Mining Lease (gold; Niger State), and Exploration Licences at Ngaski/Magama, Mashegu, Dambam and Suru
- Minerals named in licence titles: gold, lithium, spodumene, iron ore. Exploration has also identified cobalt and nickel
- Lines of business: mining and mineral exploration, value addition (planned processing), integrated agriculture, export partnerships
- Exploration is led by consultant geologists formally appointed by the Board
